title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity & version bumps
author: Ava Kim
description:
Context: SDK surface differences between Python, TypeScript and Go have caused maintenance friction and subtle behavioral differences for auth, retry logic, and streaming APIs. This PR unifies the ergonomics and contracts across the three official SDKs so applications can rely on consistent behavior and so we can keep parity tests small and effective.

What I changed: consolidated the public auth API (AuthClient / set_api_key / from_env), standardized retry/backoff defaults and backoff hooks, and aligned streaming callback signatures to accept a single Event type with consistent error handling. Each SDK also had a minor version bump and CHANGELOG entry.

Key goals addressed: consistent auth experience (explicit client + env fallback), identical default retry policy (max_retries=3, base_delay=100ms, jitter=true), streaming parity (on_event/on_error/on_complete with same event shape), and backwards-compatible alias shims where appropriate.

Files touched are limited to the SDK packages (sdks/python, sdks/typescript, sdks/go), their test suites, and docs/CHANGELOGs. This is intentionally scoped to avoid touching runtime/server code.

Testing: unit tests added/upgraded in each SDK, integration smoke tests in the CI matrix (python/ts/go), and a parity test harness that compares canonical request/response/event sequences across languages. CI had a flaky integration job which was rerun and passed.

Migration notes: existing callers should continue to work; small deprecation warnings were added for older auth helpers. Consumers that relied on the previous streaming callback signature must update to the unified Event shape; a compatibility shim logs a single warning for one release cycle.

Checklist:
- [x] Python SDK: auth/retries/streaming updates + tests + changelog
- [x] TypeScript SDK: mirror changes + tests + changelog
- [x] Go SDK: mirror changes + tests + changelog
- [x] CI matrix updated to include parity smoke step
- [x] Version bumps and release notes

Related Linear: ENG-1823 (SDK parity), ENG-2011 (retry defaults audit).
